protocol: Three seeds (137,271,389); 5000x20 make_classification, stratified 60/20/20; transformations fit on train only; identical per-seed MCAR test masks across all methods. Validation completed before any held-out metrics.
primary_metric: mean AP across clean, 10%, 30%, 50% MCAR held-out rows
candidate: recon_beta: MLP with explicit mask input, masked-value MSE auxiliary loss weight 0.2, per-row p=0.5*Beta(2,1), 30 epochs, Adam lr=.002, weight_decay=1e-4, batch 128, widths 64/32
primary_control: same MLP and augmentation but reconstruction loss removed (no_recon_beta)
additional_controls: median train-median imputation + indicator HGB max_iter=120
same aux loss with uniform p~U[0,0.5]
same aux loss without explicit mask input
decision_rule: supported pilot only if candidate mean held-out AP exceeds no_recon_beta by >=0.005 and no clean-condition AP loss >0.01; otherwise no_gain if paired mean delta <=0, inconclusive if positive delta below threshold. This is a pilot threshold, not statistical significance.
validation_tuning: No parameter tuning; fixed settings from proposal translated to runnable MLP.
heldout_policy: One final run per seed; no tuning or rerun after reading held-out scores.
